method: Targeted primary-source investigation; not exhaustive review

sources.title: Decomposition Dilemmas: Does Claim Decomposition Boost or Burden Fact-Checking Performance?
sources.read_scope: Publisher metadata; PDF introduction, methods pp.2-4 and decomposition error/result search passages. Not all appendix examples.
sources.supports: Decomposition effects depend on verifier, input granularity and introduced noise; finer claims are not uniformly better.
sources.cannot_infer: Its open retrieval, binary entailment aggregation and model-specific outcomes do not give a causal explanation or expected gain for this closed-context v4.
sources.exposure: Methods page expanded dataset names/tables but no new sample file; any illustrations are not reusable fixtures.

sources.title: MiniCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of LLMs on Grounding Documents
sources.authors: Liyan Tang et al.; exact full author list not reverified in this role
sources.read_scope: Author repository overview; primary PDF section7 extraction/decontextualization discussion from indexed full text. Author list not independently metadata checked here.
sources.supports: Decomposition and decontextualization did not consistently help in its experiments; specialized verifiers require task-specific validation.
sources.cannot_infer: Neither a universal case against decomposition nor transferable cost/model accuracy guarantee. No MiniCheck weights installed or tested.
sources.exposure: Only aggregate description; no dataset files fetched.

sources.title: Evaluating and Improving Evidence-Grounded Fact-Checking in LLMs via Multi-Round Evidence Ablation
sources.read_scope: Primary abstract and metadata; no full method replication.
sources.supports: FAE removes cited evidence to test evidence dependence; REAL is a training approach. Static accuracy can coexist with weak evidence dependence.
sources.cannot_infer: No transfer of training gains; a valid deletion test must remove all alternative support and retain no direct contradiction.
sources.exposure: No raw datasets or selected test examples opened.

sources.title: Detecting hallucinations with LLM-as-a-judge: Prompt engineering and beyond
sources.read_scope: Rubric, structured output, two-stage reasoning and measurement sections (page lines491-558).
sources.supports: Guided rubrics distinguish contradiction from lack of support; output constraints and semantic quality need separate validation.
sources.cannot_infer: Vendor scores are not independent local replication; two-call formatting is not automatically cost effective or needed, and customer tolerance choices do not replace our entailment policy.
sources.exposure: No benchmark records opened; aggregate benchmark tables only in viewed section.

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.read_scope: Official conference metadata/abstract and original-paper abstract; not all experiments.
sources.supports: Intrinsic correction without external feedback can fail or degrade reasoning; extra calls need a same-budget comparator.
sources.cannot_infer: Not a blanket impossibility result for evidence-aware auditing, current models, or all tasks.
sources.exposure: No benchmark data files or sample records opened.
